title: Folders after each write
prompt: The lesson's 12 observations cover 2026-03-07 (5 readings) and 2026-03-08 (7 readings). This program writes them partitioned by day, then writes one late reading for 2026-03-09 three different ways. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
import os
from datetime import date, datetime

path = "/tmp/c2/obs"


def folders():
    return sorted(d for d in os.listdir(path) if "=" in d)


observations.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("observation_date").parquet(path)
print(folders())

late = spark.createDataFrame([("OBS-000013", "NYC-01", datetime(2026, 3, 9, 0, 0), date(2026, 3, 9), 0.5, 78, 0.0, 10.0, 1015.0, "ok")], observations.schema)
late.write.mode("append").partitionBy("observation_date").parquet(path)
print(len(folders()), spark.read.parquet(path).count())

late.write.mode("overwrite").option("partitionOverwriteMode", "dynamic").partitionBy("observation_date").parquet(path)
print(len(folders()), spark.read.parquet(path).count())

late.write.mode("overwrite").partitionBy("observation_date").parquet(path)
print(folders(), spark.read.parquet(path).count())
hints: `partitionBy` makes one `observation_date=...` folder per day; the list is sorted.
`append` adds a new day's folder. A dynamic overwrite replaces only the folder for 2026-03-09.
A plain overwrite replaces the whole path, every day.
